name: Random Picker
description: Randomly pick one or more winners from a list, or split the whole list into evenly-sized random teams — fair, secure randomness for raffles, giveaways, and team assignments.

faq.question: Can the same person be picked twice as a winner?
faq.answer: No — "Pick winners" draws without replacement, so each item in your list can be picked at most once, the same way names are drawn from a hat one at a time.

faq.question: How are teams balanced?
faq.answer: The list is shuffled first, then dealt out round-robin across the requested number of teams — so team sizes differ by at most one when your list doesn't divide evenly, and which specific people end up together is fully randomized.
